Usage: upbrr [options] <input path>...

Commands:
  serve [options]
      Start the embedded web UI server
      Options: --addr, --host, --port, --base-url, --persist-web-config, --dev-no-auth
  api-token <list|revoke> [options]
      List and revoke persistent API bearer tokens
  auth <password|browse-roots> [options]
      Manage the WebUI password and browse policy locally

Options:

Config:
  -config, --config string
      Path to config file
  -export-config, --export-config string
      Export SQLite config to YAML file and exit
  -export-config-plaintext, --export-config-plaintext
      Export config with plaintext secrets (requires --export-config)
  -import-config, --import-config string
      Import config file (.py, .yaml, .yml, .json) and exit
  -create-auth, --create-auth
      Create web-auth.json beside the active database and exit

Application:
  -version, --version
      Show version and exit
  -cleanup, --cleanup
      Delete all stored database content for all releases and exit

Execution:
  -queue, --queue string
      Process an entire folder queue
  -limit-queue, --limit-queue, -lq int
      Limit the number of queued items to process
  -site-check, --site-check, -sc
      Search/check sites without uploading
  -site-upload, --site-upload, -su string
      Process a single tracker upload flow
  -debug, --debug
      Enable debug mode
  -log-level, --log-level string
      Set application log level for this run (error, warn, info, debug, trace)
  --console-log-level, -cll string
      Set console log level for this run without changing application logs (error, warn, info, debug, trace)
  -upload-only, --upload-only
      Upload using prepared metadata cache only
  -delete-tmp, --delete-tmp, -dtmp
      Delete stored database content for each input path before upload
  -unattended, --unattended, -ua
      Unattended mode
  -unattended_confirm, --unattended_confirm, -uac
      Unattended mode with prompts

Tracker Selection:
  -trackers, --trackers, -tk string
      Upload to these trackers (comma-separated)
  -trackers-remove, --trackers-remove, -rtk string
      Remove these trackers (comma-separated)

Tracker IDs:
  -ptp, --ptp string
      PTP torrent id or URL
  -blu, --blu string
      BLU torrent id or URL
  -aither, --aither string
      Aither torrent id or URL
  -lst, --lst string
      LST torrent id or URL
  -oe, --oe string
      OE torrent id or URL
  -hdb, --hdb string
      HDB torrent id or URL
  -btn, --btn string
      BTN torrent id or URL
  -bhd, --bhd string
      BHD torrent id or URL
  -ulcx, --ulcx string
      ULCX torrent id or URL

Release Overrides:
  -category, --category, -c string
      Override category
  -type, --type, -t string
      Override release type
  -source, --source string
      Override source
  -resolution, --resolution, -res string
      Override resolution
  -tag, --tag, -g string
      Override group tag
  -service, --service, -serv string
      Override streaming service
  -distributor, --distributor, -dist string
      Override distributor
  -original-language, --original-language, -ol string
      Override original language
  -edition, --edition, -repack string
      Override edition text
  -season, --season string
      Override season value (single token such as 5 or S05)
  -episode, --episode string
      Override episode value (single token such as 5 or E05)
  -episode-title, --episode-title, -manual-episode-title, -met string
      Override episode title
  -manual-year, --manual-year, -year int
      Override release year
  -daily, --daily string
      Set daily episode air date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  -region, --region, -reg string
      Override disc region
  -no-season, --no-season
      Remove season and episode from name
  -no-year, --no-year
      Remove year from name
  -no-aka, --no-aka
      Remove AKA from name
  -no-tag, --no-tag
      Remove group tag from name
  -no-episode-title, --no-episode-title, -net
      Remove episode title from name
  -no-distributor, --no-distributor, -ndist
      Remove distributor
  -no-edition, --no-edition, -ne
      Remove edition from name
  -no-dub, --no-dub
      Remove dubbed tag from audio name
  -no-dual, --no-dual
      Remove dual-audio tag from audio name
  -dual-audio, --dual-audio
      Add dual-audio tag to audio name

Metadata IDs:
  -tmdb, --tmdb string
      Override TMDB id
  -imdb, --imdb string
      Override IMDb id
  -mal, --mal int
      Override MAL id
  -tvdb, --tvdb int
      Override TVDB id
  -tvmaze, --tvmaze int
      Override TVmaze id

Tracker Overrides:
  -skip-dupe-check, --skip-dupe-check, -sdc
      Skip dupe check
  -skip-dupe-asking, --skip-dupe-asking, -sda
      Skip dupe asking
  -double-dupe-check, --double-dupe-check, -ddc
      Double dupe check
  -foreign, --foreign
      Mark TIK release as foreign
  -opera, --opera
      Mark TIK release as opera or musical
  -asian, --asian
      Mark TIK release as asian
  -disctype, --disctype string
      Override TIK disc type
  -commentary, --commentary, -mc
      Mark release as containing commentary
  -personalrelease, --personalrelease, -pr
      Mark release as personal
  -stream, --stream, -st
      Mark release as stream optimized
  -webdv, --webdv
      Mark release as WEB-DV
  -not-anime, --not-anime
      Force release to be treated as not anime
  -anon, --anon, -a
      Upload anonymously
  -draft, --draft, -dr
      Send uploads to drafts where supported
  -modq, --modq, -mq
      Opt into mod queue where supported
  -channel, --channel, -ch string
      Override SPD channel

Screenshots and Images:
  -screens, --screens, -s int
      Number of screenshots to take
  -manual_frames, --manual_frames, -mf string
      Comma-separated frame numbers to use for screenshots
  -comparison, --comparison, -comps string
      Comparison folder path or comma-separated paths
  -comparison_index, --comparison_index, -comps_index int
      Primary comparison index
  -menu-images, --menu-images string
      Path to manually captured disc menu screenshots (Disc releases only)
  -get-dvd-menus, --get-dvd-menus
      Capture distinct menus from an extracted DVD VIDEO_TS (requires compatible FFmpeg)
  -imghost, --imghost, -ih string
      Override image host
  -skip-imagehost-upload, --skip-imagehost-upload, -siu
      Skip automatic image host uploads
  -descfile, --descfile, -df string
      Custom description file path
  -desclink, --desclink, -pb string
      Custom description link

Client and Torrent:
  -client, --client string
      Override torrent client
  -qbit-tag, --qbit-tag, -qbt string
      Override qBittorrent tag
  -qbit-cat, --qbit-cat, -qbc string
      Override qBittorrent category
  -force-recheck, --force-recheck, -frc
      Force recheck matched qBittorrent torrents before validation
  -no-seed, --no-seed, -ns
      Do not inject torrent into clients
  -skip_auto_torrent, --skip_auto_torrent, -sat
      Skip automated torrent client searching
  -keep-folder, --keep-folder, -kf
      Keep a supplied folder instead of processing its selected video file directly
  -onlyID, --onlyID
      Only grab tracker metadata IDs
  -infohash, --infohash, -th, -torrenthash string
      Override v1 info hash
  -max-piece-size, --max-piece-size, -mps int
      Set maximum torrent piece size in MiB
  -nohash, --nohash, -nh
      Reuse existing torrents only without generating a new one
  -rehash, --rehash, -rh
      Force generation of a fresh torrent
